content:
Hi everyone! I’m Pietro, a freelance developer and researcher working on Lean 4 and autoformalization. I’ve worked with Numina, including on the Kakeya-3d formalization. I also contribute to the open source project Vampire, an ATP that won multiple awards.

I’d love to meet more people and teams working on autoformalization. If you’d like to exchange ideas or chat about a possible collaboration, feel free to DM me!
